-- Rename course_i18n to course_version_i18n and link to course_version
BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.course_i18n') IS NOT NULL
       AND to_regclass('public.course_version_i18n') IS NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE course_i18n RENAME TO course_version_i18n;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS course_version_id uuid;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version_i18n' AND column_name = 'course_id'
    ) THEN
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'version'
        ) THEN
            IF EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                WHERE table_name = 'course' AND column_name = 'current_version_id'
            ) THEN
                EXECUTE $sql$
                    WITH picked AS (
                        SELECT
                            c.id AS course_id,
                            COALESCE(c.current_version_id, cv.id) AS course_version_id
                        FROM course c
                        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                            SELECT cv.id
                            FROM course_version cv
                            WHERE cv.course_id = c.id
                            ORDER BY (cv.is_default = true) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.version DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) cv ON TRUE
                    )
                    UPDATE course_version_i18n cvi
                    SET course_version_id = p.course_version_id
                    FROM picked p
                    WHERE cvi.course_id = p.course_id
                $sql$;
            ELSE
                EXECUTE $sql$
                    WITH picked AS (
                        SELECT
                            c.id AS course_id,
                            cv.id AS course_version_id
                        FROM course c
                        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                            SELECT cv.id
                            FROM course_version cv
                            WHERE cv.course_id = c.id
                            ORDER BY (cv.is_default = true) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.version DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) cv ON TRUE
                    )
                    UPDATE course_version_i18n cvi
                    SET course_version_id = p.course_version_id
                    FROM picked p
                    WHERE cvi.course_id = p.course_id
                $sql$;
            END IF;
        ELSE
            IF EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                WHERE table_name = 'course' AND column_name = 'current_version_id'
            ) THEN
                EXECUTE $sql$
                    WITH picked AS (
                        SELECT
                            c.id AS course_id,
                            COALESCE(c.current_version_id, cv.id) AS course_version_id
                        FROM course c
                        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                            SELECT cv.id
                            FROM course_version cv
                            WHERE cv.course_id = c.id
                            ORDER BY (cv.is_default = true) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.created_at DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) cv ON TRUE
                    )
                    UPDATE course_version_i18n cvi
                    SET course_version_id = p.course_version_id
                    FROM picked p
                    WHERE cvi.course_id = p.course_id
                $sql$;
            ELSE
                EXECUTE $sql$
                    WITH picked AS (
                        SELECT
                            c.id AS course_id,
                            cv.id AS course_version_id
                        FROM course c
                        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                            SELECT cv.id
                            FROM course_version cv
                            WHERE cv.course_id = c.id
                            ORDER BY (cv.is_default = true) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.created_at DESC
                            LIMIT 1
                        ) cv ON TRUE
                    )
                    UPDATE course_version_i18n cvi
                    SET course_version_id = p.course_version_id
                    FROM picked p
                    WHERE cvi.course_id = p.course_id
                $sql$;
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;
END $$;

DELETE FROM course_version_i18n WHERE course_version_id IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    ALTER COLUMN course_version_id SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_i18n_pkey,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_version_i18n_pkey;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_course_i18n_course_id;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_course_i18n_i18n_id;

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS course_id;

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    ADD PRIMARY KEY (course_version_id, i18n_id);

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_course_version_i18n_course_version') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
            ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_version_i18n_course_version
            FOREIGN KEY (course_version_id) REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_i18n_course_version_id ON course_version_i18n(course_version_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_i18n_i18n_id ON course_version_i18n(i18n_id);

COMMIT;
